effects: The signer sends `assets` USDT to the vault through safeTransferFrom (ERC4626._deposit), which spends the signer's USDT allowance to the vault.
The vault mints bbUSDT shares to `receiver`. The number is computed from storage: assets * (totalSupply + 1e12) / (totalAssets + 1), rounded down, after fees accrue.
The USDT is then supplied to Morpho Blue markets in the vault's name. The signer keeps no direct position there.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", the USDT amount, a fixed 'Share ticker: bbUSDT' line, and the share receiver.

findings.title: deposit: the number of bbUSDT shares received is not shown; the vault price in storage decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor). The descriptor shows only 'Share ticker' = $.metadata.constants.vaultTicker, with no amount.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. A label such as 'Receive bbUSDT shares (at vault price)' could make this clear.

findings.title: deposit: the intent 'Deposit' names no amount, asset or vault, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} into bbUSDT vault for {receiver}".

findings.title: deposit: the only mined case reverted, so no on-chain effect checks the screen.
findings.fix: Use a successful deposit transaction as the test case.

cases.notes: The transaction reverted (status 0) and moved nothing. The reader correctly expected 0.1 USDT out and bbUSDT in to their own address.

effects: The signer pays USDT to the vault through safeTransferFrom. The amount is computed from storage: shares * (totalAssets + 1) / (totalSupply + 1e12), rounded up. The calldata sets no maximum; only the signer's allowance limits it.
The vault mints exactly `shares` bbUSDT to `receiver`.
The USDT is supplied to Morpho Blue markets in the vault's name.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", 'Deposit asset: USDT' with no amount, the exact bbUSDT share amount, and the share receiver.

findings.title: mint: the USDT amount pulled from the signer is not shown and has no bound in the calldata.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint(): assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); ERC4626._deposit: safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets). The descriptor shows only the raw 'Deposit asset' = "USDT".
findings.fix: No calldata value carries the amount. Relabel the field 'Pays USDT (amount set by vault share price)' so the signer knows USDT leaves.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays USDT; there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint: "intent": "Mint". The blind reader in case 1 was unsure how much USDT leaves and why.
findings.fix: Use intent 'Mint vault shares (pay USDT)' and interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} for {receiver}, paid in USDT".

findings.title: mint: the only mined case reverted, so no on-chain effect checks the screen.
findings.fix: Use a successful mint transaction as the test case.

cases.notes: The transaction reverted with no effects. The screen correctly shows the 0.000000001 bbUSDT going to the dEaD address.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns bbUSDT shares from `owner`. The number is computed from storage, rounded up, and is not in the calldata.
If the caller is not `owner`, the caller's bbUSDT allowance from `owner` is spent by that share amount.
The vault sends exactly `assets` USDT to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", the exact USDT amount, the receiver and the owner whose shares are burned.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of bbUSDT shares burned from the owner is not shown; the vault price decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw(): shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); ERC4626._withdraw: _burn(owner, shares).
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. A label could say 'Burns bbUSDT shares of owner (at vault price)'.

findings.title: withdraw: the intent 'Withdraw' names no amount or vault; there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} from bbUSDT vault to {receiver}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` bbUSDT from `owner`. If the caller is not `owner`, this spends the caller's allowance from `owner`.
The vault sends USDT to `receiver`. The amount is computed from storage: shares * (totalAssets + 1) / (totalSupply + 1e12), rounded down. The calldata sets no minimum.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", the bbUSDT shares to redeem, the receiver and the owner. The asset received is not named and its amount is not shown.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names USDT as the asset the signer receives.
findings.evidence: cases/2.json: the signer received 110888625 USDT (signer: in), and no screen field mentions USDT. MetaMorpho.sol redeem() -> ERC4626._withdraw: safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets). The mint format already shows $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker, but redeem does not.
findings.fix: Add a field {"label":"Receive asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"} and name USDT in the intent.

findings.title: redeem: the USDT amount received depends on the vault price, and the calldata sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem(): assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor). Case 2 received 110.888625 USDT, and no field shows it.

findings.title: redeem: the intent 'Redeem' names no amount, asset or vault; there is no interpolatedIntent.

cases.notes: The 102.95 bbUSDT burned from the signer is shown correctly. The 110.888625 USDT received is not named and its amount is not shown, so the reader had to guess USDT.
